text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report responds to an application submitted by the property owner of 8 Markwood Crescent requesting approval for a site-specific Fence Exemption under Section 447-1.2B (1) of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 – Fences. The purpose of this report is to advise Community Council regarding an application by the property owner of 8 Markwood Crescent for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Section 447-1.2B (1) of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447 – Fences. The property owner is seeking Community Council’s permission to maintain an existing 3 panel wood fence with lattice on the Northwest side of the property. The first panel extend beyond the front wall of the house. Second and Third Panels: The applicable by-law fence height…

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for fence exemption for the first western-most panel at the front of the house, on the condition that the overall height of the next two panels to the east be lowered to 2.0 metres and that there is a height reduction of the post in between the second and third panels by an equal amount, and direct and require that the existing fence be maintained in good repair without alteration and that at such time as replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
